verses.text: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.

xrefs.text: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise in the assembly of the godly.
Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
And I looked and saw above the expanse, above the heads of the cherubim, the likeness of a throne of sapphire.

verses.text: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.

xrefs.text: “O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?
“Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!
Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!

verses.text: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.

xrefs.text: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.

verses.text: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.

xrefs.text: The LORD will save me; we will play songs on stringed instruments all the days of our lives in the house of the LORD.
Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.
I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—
with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.

verses.text: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.

xrefs.text: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments— harps, lyres, and cymbals.

Additionally, David and the commanders of the army set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to prophesy with the accompaniment of lyres, harps, and cymbals. The following is the list of the men who performed this service:
So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sounding of rams’ horns and trumpets, and with cymbals and the music of harps and lyres.
The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals.

All these were under the direction of their fathers for the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the direction of the king.

verses.text: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!

xrefs.text: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.

And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!
Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
